verdict.rationale: The only evidence is one 2023 community hands-on report of a 'generous free tier' that held 300k embeddings at about 10% capacity, which directly speaks to prototyping without paying. No first-party pricing or plan documentation is in the pack, and another user from the same period reported being unable to sign up for a starter account because of demand. missing for 10: first-party documentation of free/starter tier limits and features, current corroboration that the free tier is available and covers serverless, inference and assistant features, clarity on signup availability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: I'm still surprised by their generous free tier, I have a database of 300k embeddings on Pinecone and it's only 10% full by their metrics
